Other words

  • vestīmentum, vestīmentī n. — item of clothing

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Traupman 116; Traupman 292

  • vestītus, vestītūs m. — clothing, dress, attire

    noun, fourth declension · also used · classical · Cic. Att. 1.13.3: vestītus muliebris (Lewis & Short); Traupman 116; Traupman 292

  • forēnsia, forēnsium n. pl. — dress of state, formal clothes worn in public

    noun, third declension, plural · also used · classical · Suet. Aug. 73 (Lewis & Short s.v. forēnsis); Traupman 118

    Lewis & Short’s “dress of state”; Traupman gives it for street clothes.

See also get dressed, put on, take off.
